Items.NoPythonVenv_Description: Allows ASI to use Python's default executable instead of a separated Python virtual environment. It is not recommended to enable this option (it's better to use a separated virtual environment), but if Python's virtual environment fails to execute you might want to give it a try.
Items.DebugLogging_Description: If debug logging is enabled, three additional files are created in the json_exports folder when the JSON files are created: skipped_blueprints.json, unknown_blueprints.json and failed_to_parse.json. These JSON files provide information about which objects were skipped, which objects were unknown, and which objects failed to parse.
